233: [edit] We are obligated to fast on Tisha B'Av {ninth of the month of Av}, and on the seventeenth of Tammuz and on the third of Tishrei and on the tenth on Tevet because of the bad things which occured on them.

[edit] Even though it says in the pasuk: "On the fourth month, on the ninth of the month, the city was breached" {Jeremiah 39,2}, we do not fast on the ninth of [day of] it {Tamuz}, rather [we fast] on the seventeenth. Even though for the [destruction of the] first [Temple] it was breached on the ninth, since for the second [Temple] it was breached on the seventeenth of it, they determined to fast on the seventeenth of it, because the destruction of the second temple is harsher for us.
